type.markdownDescription:
### ⚠️ Requires [Sync](https://modrinth.com/mod/sync) to be installed! ⚠️

Modifies damage taken from entities based on the level of a specific enchantment on the attacker's equipment.

enchantment.description: The enchantment whose level on the attacker's equipment determines the bonus.
enchantment.markdownDescription: The enchantment whose level on the attacker's equipment determines the bonus.

base_value.description: Starting value before any level-based scaling.
base_value.markdownDescription: Starting value before any level-based scaling.

damage_condition.description: If present, the modification only applies when the damage condition is met.
damage_condition.markdownDescription: If present, the modification only applies when the damage condition is met.

bientity_condition.description: If present, the modification only applies when the bi-entity condition between attacker and target is met.
bientity_condition.markdownDescription: If present, the modification only applies when the bi-entity condition between attacker and target is met.

modifier.description: Modifier applied repeatedly to scale the bonus per enchantment level.
modifier.markdownDescription: Modifier applied repeatedly to scale the bonus per enchantment level.

bientity_action.description: Action to execute on the attacker and target when damage is taken.
bientity_action.markdownDescription: Action to execute on the attacker and target when damage is taken.
